order: Tighten launch discipline for the cross-vendor executor and reviewer launchers. Every launcher starts from the repository root, not an arbitrary working directory, so relative paths resolve consistently regardless of where the parent process was invoked from. Each launcher's output goes into the shared scratch directory, not scattered wherever the process happened to run. The review warmup step pins to a known checkout, exercising exactly the state the review will actually run against rather than a stale or unrelated one. Apply the same three fixes across all three files — the base executor, the heavy executor, and the reviewer launcher script — so their startup behavior stays consistent with one another. Keep each script's existing command-line interface the same; the startup and warmup discipline are the only pieces that change, and every other behavior in these files carries over exactly as it did before.
claims: We fixed launch discipline across exactly three launcher scripts — each now starts only from the repository root, writes its output only to the scratch directory, and pins the review warmup to the checkout under test. The three files changed by 90 insertions and 24 deletions, with the base executor, heavy executor, and reviewer launchers kept consistent with one another. Each script's startup path was traced manually line by line to confirm the repo-root working directory takes effect before any relative-path use.
